_doc: Reference-plate manifest for Red Maple (Acer rubrum). Stage-0 source list; binaries download in Stage-1 ingest (downloaded:false). Jacob ratifies identification (ratified:false).
identityNotes: V-shaped (sharp/angular) sinuses, serrated/toothed margins, and red twigs/petioles separate it from sugar maple. The most reliable bright-red fall of the three maples; red recurs in twigs, early flowers, fruit, and fall.

plates.caption: Rounded-oval crown; 3–5 lobed toothed leaves with red petioles.
Brilliant red autumn foliage, the species' signature.
Grey bark, smooth on young trees becoming vertically ridged/striped.
